say:1:1910530001:1.text: We came to see you, Mister Calix.
say:1:1910530001:1.source_cn: 卡律先生，我们来看你了……

say:2:1910530002:1.text: Don't come closer. If you have something to say, say it from there.

say:3:1910530003:1.text: I know you don't really want to hurt us! There's no need to avoid us...
say:3:1910530003:1.source_cn: 我知道你其实不想伤害我们！你完全没必要躲着我们呀……

say:4:1910530004:1.text: 我知道自己在做什么，浅海裔的女儿。如果不想你和你的族裔被撕碎，就出去。
say:4:1910530004:1.source_cn: 我知道自己在做什么，浅海裔的女儿。如果不想你和你的族裔...

say:5:1910530005:1.text: Have those two ask the questions. I won't feel an urge to kill them.
say:5:1910530005:1.source_cn: 有话让那两个人问，我不会对他们产生杀意。
say:5:1910530005:1.male: Have those two ask the questions. I won't feel an urge to kill them.
say:5:1910530005:1.female: Have those two ask the questions. I won't feel an urge to kill them.

narration:9:1910530007:1.text: Elphira looks sadly at you, lowers her head, and walks out in silence.
narration:9:1910530007:1.male: Elphira looks sadly at you, lowers her head, and walks out in silence.
narration:9:1910530007:1.female: Elphira looks sadly at you, lowers her head, and walks out in silence.

say:13:1910530009:1.text: 我看到你做了什么，你的天赋……很了不起。
say:13:1910530009:1.source_cn: 我看到你做了什么，你的天赋……很了不起。

say:15:1910530012:1.text: Tentacle guy, where the heck did that glowing tide come from?
say:15:1910530012:1.source_cn: 触手男，那些海水一样的光是哪儿来的？

say:16:1910530013:1.text: From the Deepsea. It welled up from below. The other Deepfolk... the ones who attacked Coralia, they all dissolved into sparks and foam inside the glowing tide.
say:16:1910530013:1.source_cn: 深海，自下而上涌来。其他深海裔……那些袭击塔拉萨的族裔...

choice_prompt:17:1910530013.text: From the Deepsea. It welled up from below. The other Deepfolk... the ones who attacked Coralia, they all dissolved into sparks and foam inside the glowing tide.
choice_prompt:17:1910530013.source_cn: 深海，自下而上涌来。其他深海裔……那些袭击塔拉萨的族裔，都在潮光里化成了光点和泡沫。

say:18:1910530014:1.text:
Deepfolk. Our home. Madmen and lunatics. What else could there be?
Madmen...
say:18:1910530014:1.source_cn: 深海族裔，我们的家，狂人、疯子，还能有什么？\n狂人……

choice:17:1:2.text: Before the glowing tide came, did you see anything unusual?
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 潮光来袭之前，有没有异常？
choice:17:1:2.male: Before the glowing tide came, did you see anything unusual?
choice:17:1:2.female: Before the glowing tide came, did you see anything unusual?

say:20:1910530016:1.text: Call that Shallowfolk girl back in. I need to confirm something. But don't let her get close...
say:20:1910530016:1.source_cn: 叫那个浅海裔的女儿进来，要找她确认，但别让她靠近……

say:22:1910530017:1.text: I'm right here! I've been listening at the door this whole time. What do you need from me?
say:22:1910530017:1.source_cn: ——我在！我一直在门外偷听呢，需要我做什么？

say:24:1910530019:1.text: Is there a long-haired man in Coralia whose <style="highlight">lower body is nothing but a translucent tail bone</style>?
say:24:1910530019:1.source_cn: 塔拉萨有没有一个长发男性，<style=highlig...

say:25:1910530020:1.text: Only tail bone...? It sounds like that man was seriously hurt... Is he okay?
say:25:1910530020:1.source_cn: 只剩尾骨……？听起来那位先生受伤很严重呀，他、他没事吗？

choice_prompt:26:1910530020.text: Only tail bone...? It sounds like that man was seriously hurt... Is he okay?
choice_prompt:26:1910530020.source_cn: 只剩尾骨……？听起来那位先生受伤很严重呀，他、他没事吗？

say:28:1910530022:1.text: I've heard of them. People who are dead but can still move. I never saw one on land either.
say:28:1910530022:1.source_cn: 咱听说过，是死了还能动的人，咱在陆地上都没见过！

say:29:1910530023:1.text: When I was bringing Garnet up, I caught a glimpse of him. He was watching Coralia from afar, unmoving.
say:29:1910530023:1.source_cn: 我带歌尼特上浮的时候瞥见了，他在远处望着塔拉萨，一动不动。

say:30:1910530024:1.text: Not long after he dove down, the glowing tide started welling up.
say:30:1910530024:1.source_cn: 他下潜到更深处之后不久，潮光开始涌上来。

say:31:1910530025:1.text: He wasn't a member of the Deepfolk. He had a tail fin and the face of a Shallowfolk.
say:31:1910530025:1.source_cn: 那人绝不是深海族裔，他有塔拉萨人的尾鳍和脸庞。

choice_prompt:32:1910530025.text: He wasn't a member of the Deepfolk. He had a tail fin and the face of a Shallowfolk.
choice_prompt:32:1910530025.source_cn: 那人绝不是深海族裔，他有塔拉萨人的尾鳍和脸庞。

say:33:1910530026:1.text: He must be behind all of this!
say:33:1910530026:1.source_cn: 嘁，肯定是那混蛋搞的鬼！

say:34:1910530027:1.text: Let's go ask Grandma. She knows the lineages of every family and clan. If that man really is from Coralia or was once from here, she'll definitely know.
say:34:1910530027:1.source_cn: 去问问阿嬷吧，她了解每一家的族谱。如果那个人真是塔拉萨...

choice:32:0:1.text: The glowing tide is likely connected to him.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 潮光出现，很可能和他有关
choice:32:0:1.male: The glowing tide is likely connected to him.
choice:32:0:1.female: The glowing tide is likely connected to him.

choice:32:1:2.text: A Graveborn not connected to anyone. He's suspicious.
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 不属于任何族裔的亡灵，他最可疑！
choice:32:1:2.male: A Graveborn not connected to anyone. He's suspicious.
choice:32:1:2.female: A Graveborn not connected to anyone. He's suspicious.

choice:26:0:1.text: Do you mean you saw a Graveborn?
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 你是说，你见到一个亡灵？！
choice:26:0:1.male: Do you mean you saw a Graveborn?
choice:26:0:1.female: Do you mean you saw a Graveborn?

choice:12:0:1.text: The Shallowfolk have taken good care of me.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 塔拉萨人把我照顾得很好
choice:12:0:1.male: The Shallowfolk have taken good care of me.
choice:12:0:1.female: The Shallowfolk have taken good care of me.

say:36:1910530010:1.text: 我看到你做了什么，你的天赋……很了不起。
say:36:1910530010:1.source_cn: 我看到你做了什么，你的天赋……很了不起。

choice:12:1:2.text: I've never stayed in bed for so long.
choice:12:1:2.male: I've never stayed in bed for so long.
choice:12:1:2.female: I've never stayed in bed for so long.

choice:12:2:3.text: It's good to see that both you and your brother are safe.
choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 太好了，你和弟弟都平安无事
choice:12:2:3.male: It's good to see that both you and your brother are safe.
choice:12:2:3.female: It's good to see that both you and your brother are safe.
